note: Independent re-judgment on 2026-11-25 against RFC 1195 Section 4.5 ('There may be times when a dual router has to forward an IP packet to an OSI-only router, or forward an OSI packet to an IP-only router. In this case the packet must be discarded.'). In TestFIBOnLinkAdjacencyAndUnsupportedPrefix, commit 1f82b2727d only renamed iface.LoadBackend("netlink") to iface.LoadBackend("kernel") (the same newNetlinkBackend) and reworded two comments; all assertions are unchanged. Positive: installs a usable default route as control, installs routetype.Unreachable for 203.0.113.0/24, and asserts kernel RouteGet(203.0.113.9) returns unix.EHOSTUNREACH rather than falling through to the default; unchanged IS-IS units TestRFC1195OSINeighborIsTerminalIPv4NextHop and TestRFC1195CapabilityChangesInstalledRouteDisposition pin OSI-only next-hop rejection and Unreachable disposition. Negative: withdrawing the Unreachable route restores forwarding for 203.0.113.9 via the same default gateway, alongside unchanged TestRFC1195NeighborProtocolTransitions and TestRFC1195CapabilityChangesInstalledRouteDisposition#2. OSI half: Ze forwards no CLNP packets.
